root.label: House Oversight requests Kimberly Guilfoyle records

events.label: House Oversight requests Kimberly Guilfoyle records

slots.name: time since report
slots.sentence: The letter, sent to Guilfoyle by committee ranking member Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., and obtained first by PBS News, came a day after The Wall Street Journal reported that she had requested money from a donor in return for official acts.

slots.name: communications period
slots.sentence: Garcia set a deadline of Oct. 22 for Guilfoyle to hand over a number of materials related to the allegations, including all personal financial records, as well as two years' worth of communications with Deter and members of the Trump administration, including FBI Director Kash Patel and former Attorney General Pam Bondi.
